## 1. Quick Reference & Meta-Data
- **Topic:** SHAP-based interpretation and optimization guidance for zeolite synthesis, with emphasis on particle-size control
- **Primary Aim of the Study:** Use machine learning explanations to identify synthesis conditions associated with smaller particle sizes, and then translate those insights into optimization guidance
- **Core XAI Tool:** SHAP
- **Claimed Added Value:** The study attempts to move beyond passive model interpretation and use SHAP-derived insights to guide synthesis toward desirable outcomes
- **My Overall Assessment:** Interesting and ambitious idea, but the methodology and interpretation are weaker than they first appear. The paper uses SHAP in an exploratory and suggestive way, but it does not fully validate whether the extracted explanations actually support reliable optimization.
